note: hour offset: hour = fmod(timeBase + tick * timeScale, 24) [I]; SetTime(h) stores h - hourNow

name: manager34

name: mapObjectManager

name: itemManager

name: refHolder

name: refListPair

name: frameTick

name: waterLevels

name: zoneExitsVt

name: zoneExitEffectsVt

name: heroList

name: objectList

name: visibleListVt

name: gridB
note: second 16-unit grid (slot 42 moves objects in it; cleared by LoadZone / ClearVisibleEffects)

name: terrain
note: CTerrain (0xafc bytes, created by Init); terrain size at its +0x10c / +0x110

name: worldName
note: GIPAT / "INGOS" / "SUSLANGER" (from the map record, upper case): light tables, music, environment mask

name: particleManager
note: CParticleManager (slot 36; zone exit effects, path debug effects)

name: sky
note: the sky holder {figure object "nask0", material} (CreateSky; Render flag 0x1000)

name: moshkaEffect
note: CEffectMoshka (the guide bird) created by CreateMoshkaEffect

name: floatingNumbers
note: the damage / experience number list with the "numbers" texture (ShowFloatingNumber, CFlyingHitPoints::Draw, Render flag 0x2000)

name: bloodPrints
note: STL list (0xa4-byte nodes) of blood prints (AddBloodPrint, toggle g_0x79BD50)

name: footPrints
note: STL list (0x9c-byte nodes) of footprints (AddFootPrint, g_0x79BD4C)

name: scorchPrints
note: STL list (0x94-byte nodes) of scorch prints (AddScorchPrint, g_0x79BD54)

name: printLightCountdown
note: frames until the print colours are re-lit from the lights (g_0x79BD24)

name: netRefObject
note: refcounted helper (vt 0x73F628) pumped by Update / PumpNet (vt[5])

name: bridges
note: the walkable quads of buildings / stuff objects (types 0x54 / 0x5d): heights on bridges, shadow receivers

name: player
note: the local CPlayer (CPlayerManager::CreatePlayerWithConnection); its +0x20 = the CPlayerClient (CWorldClient::GetConnection)

name: camera
note: CCamera (SetCamera); Render uses its position for the terrain window and the sky

name: sunTable
note: 24 x rgba sun colours by hour ("sunlight" section of lights<zone>.ini)

name: ambientTable
note: 24 x rgba ambient colours ("ambient"; zero = 0.8 * sun)

name: fogTable
note: 24 x rgba fog / sky colours (third section)

name: sunColor
note: current sun colour (CTerrain::SetSunLight once per hour)

name: partyMode
note: the server's party mode from message 0x60 (0 calm, 1 hurt, 2 fighting)

name: frameCounter
note: frames since LoadZone (10 = autosave + volumes; 0x5a music reset)

name: tickOffset
note: added to the tick for the session object updates (vt[25])

name: weather
note: rain / snow (CWeatherSound, CEffectSoundObj::Update in Render, SetWind)

name: hiddenObjectIds
note: STL list of the ids hidden by HideObject (message 0x19)

name: field7c0
note: -1 after the ctor; message 0x12 writes byte << 24

name: quadListVt
note: MFC CList (vt 0x73F548) of walkable quads: 0x54-byte nodes {next, prev, BridgeQuad}

name: ownerId
note: object id of the building / stuff object the face belongs to (node +8)

name: ref1c
note: refcounted object released by the dtor

name: xMin
note: exit rectangle in world units (CRect2F::Contains; a hero inside may leave the zone)

name: rotation
note: rotation about the centre (cos / sin for the exit effect)

name: targetZone
note: none or the zone record name

name: entrance
note: the exit index in the target zone (-1 only with "none")

name: rect
note: x0, y0, x1, y1 of the exit area (map.txt _exit); centre = the arrival point of PlayerIn

name: viewAngleOverride
note: used instead of the rect direction when +0x34 is set (PlayerIn)

name: vtable
note: 0x73C960 (IStream 0x73BDB0 base 0x73BD90): slots 1 Read(buf, n), 2 Write(buf, n), 3 Seek(pos), 4 GetSize, 5 GetPos, 6 Clear / SetSize

name: ok
note: 1 while every read succeeded; a short read clears it (the dispatchers test it)

name: state
note: the LZ coder state: 1 KB ring window and the Huffman / bit writer (LzCompress 0x430450, LzDecompress 0x430960); one per direction, kept across messages

name: header
note: case-insensitive string -> float hash (StringFloatMap_Get 0x460AF0 / Set 0x460BC0 / Remove); copied whole by HashTable_CopyCtor (OnMsg80_Party keeps it in a session)

name: cells
note: w * h object lists (STL list heads) allocated by ObjGrid_Init 0x572820

name: winX0
note: render / query window (RenderObjects: camera +- 100 units; CollectObjectsNear: the square)

name: records
note: 16-byte {int id, int stepsLeft, float level, float step}

name: unitId
note: the looted unit (node payload at node +8)

name: lobbyIndex
note: LobbyServer player index or -1 (who may take it)

name: mprBase
note: + ".mpr" = the terrain / AI map file; empty = no world (camp)

name: kind
note: 0 playable zone (has mission.sav / <zone>.sav), 1 camp or map screen (zone kind 4), 2 scripted zone (world script from the .mob, zone kind 3)

name: kind
note: g_0x7AFE20 (aka PartyEntry / MpCommand): 0 none, 1 main menu, 2 load save slot, 3 new game, 4 enter zone, 5 leave to lobby / menu, 6 host multiplayer zone; handled by Session_ProcessRequest once per frame

name: zoneKind
note: pseudo-class of the session globals: g_0x7C2CC4 = CWorldServer +0x12d64 (see that row); the other CWorldServer globals: tick 0x7AFFC4, frame 0x7AFFC8, paused 0x7AFFCC, item manager 0x7AFFB4, player manager 0x7AFF98, CAIMap 0x7B00D0, relations 0x7C2BC4, mob name 0x7C2CC8, mpr name 0x7C2CCC

name: tickMs
note: g_0x78FF34: 55 (0x37) normal, 27 (0x1b) at x2 speed; the server slice length and the client interpolation step

name: serverAccumulator
note: g_0x79BC64: elapsed ms not yet consumed by CWorldServer::Tick (main loop)

name: inZoneFlag
note: g_0x79BE6C = 1 after Game_EnterZone kind 1 / Session_HostMpZone (unit AI checks it)

name: uiDirty
note: g_0x7C7D94 = 1 on every session transition (interface rebuild)

name: databaseName
note: g_0x7AFDEC: "database.res" or "databaseLMP.res" (lobby alive); Databases_LoadAll when it changes

name: balanceIndex
note: g_0x79BEC0 (saved copy g_0x79BEC4): index into the stat tables g_0x7C54A0; forced 0 in lobby games

name: scrambleOn
note: g_0x79026C: 1 while the live stats are XOR-scrambled with the key g_0x7AFECC (World_SetStatScramble)

name: mpFileVersion
note: g_0x790260 = the version MpFile::WriteContainer writes (0x74); g_0x790264 = the compressed-format threshold the reader tests

name: vtable
note: 0x743324: the header / entry table / accel table part shared by CResourceFile (0x743320, the mmio reader used by the sound system), CMappedResource (0x7432E0, 0x58) and CMappedResource2 (0x743300, 0x6c)

name: entries
note: 0x16-byte entries {u32 next (-1), u32 size, u32 offset, u32, u16 nameLen, u32 nameOffset}

name: archiveMmio
note: HMMIO of the .res; vt 0x743320; the functions named CResourceBase::Ctor / dtor / Close / OpenFile / CloseFile / Read / Seek belong to this class (CSoundManager::Init, CMusicSystem::StartStream, Mp3Stream_ReadCallback)

name: entryOffset
note: offset of the open entry (0 = none)

name: looseFileMmio
note: HMMIO of a loose file that overrides the archive entry

name: fileHandle
note: CRT handle (-1 closed); vtable 0x7432E0: 0 dtor, 1 Open(path, writable), 2 Attach(data), 3 Release, 4 nop, 5 OpenFile(name, out size) -> buffer, 6 CloseFile(buffer), 7 FreeEntries [I slot order]

name: mappedBase
note: 0 unless the archive is memory-mapped (Attach); then entries point into it

name: bufferHash
note: buffer pointer -> cached entry {.., buffer +0xc, refcount +0x14}

name: archivesBegin
note: vector of 0x10 records {std::string name, CMappedResource* +0xc}: the opened prototype archives (slot 16 OpenProtoResource / 17 CloseProtoResource / 18 ClearProtos / 19 OpenFile / 20 CloseFile / 21 HasFile / 22 FreeCachedFiles)

name: id
note: NID chunk 0xB002; -1 = assign (CreateObjectFromDesc writes the created id back)

name: name
note: 0xB004 OBJNAME (the object's +0x1a8 name; non-empty -> named hash)

name: kind
note: 1 object, 2 light, 3 sound / particle, 4 effect 0x4a, 5 unit, 6 fire / campfire, 7 magic trap, 8 lever, 9 active object (CreateObjectFromDesc switch)

name: objectName
note: 0xB004 [?] copied into the object with 0x50F150 and flags 0x20000 when non-empty

name: type
note: 0xB003: the manager creation key (0x3010 .. units, 0x35 trees ...) given to vt[23]

name: isDynamic
note: 1 after ctor; 0 -> object flag 8 (static, no tick)

name: side
note: units: player side (CUnit::SetSide, PlayerRelations forced mask)
